input_file.description: Path to the input file. Uses -1 or --in flag.

output_file.description: Path to the output file. Uses -2 or --out flag.

record_type.description: Type of record delimitation: line (-l), block (-b), record-separator (-r), or fixed-size-record (-O).

record_separator.description: Character separating records when record_type is 'record-separator'. Used with -r.

record_size.description: Size in bytes for fixed-size records when record_type is 'fixed-size-record'. Used with -O.

keys.description: List of sort key configurations. Each item is a map of key-specific options.

algorithm.description: Sort algorithm: i (InsertionSort), m (MergeSort), q (QuickSort), s (ShellSort). Used with -a.

unicode_normalization.description: Unicode normalization mode: c (NFC), d (NFD), C (NFKC), D (NFKD), n (no normalization). Used with -u.

invert_globally.description: Invert sense of comparisons globally. Used with -I.

skip_first_record.description: Copy first record to output without sorting. Used with -Z.

suppress_log.description: Suppress output to log. Used with -j.

random_seed.description: Seed for random number generator (for random sort keys). Used with -P. 0 means time-based.

check_only.description: Check if input is already sorted without output. Used with -Q.

use_cr.description: Use Carriage Return as line ending. Used with -m.

bmp_only.description: Restrict to Basic Multilingual Plane. Used with -B.

reserve_private_use_area.description: Do not use Private Use areas internally. Used with -p.

initial_max_records.description: Initial maximum number of records for memory allocation. Used with -M.

key_items.description: Schema for items within the 'keys' list. FLAT map of field-name to type/default/desc.
